correctness.rationale: The derivative of every origin-preserving holomorphic map from the balanced product to the Euclidean ball is a contraction for the product Minkowski norm. Independent phase averaging yields the exact squared-norm budget for the k disk columns and the m-dimensional ball block. Hadamard plus AM-GM gives the sharp upper determinant m^m/(k+m)^(k+m), and an explicit block-diagonal linear map attains it. The Kobayashi-Eisenman value is forced to one by the ball/product/polydisc inclusion sandwich.
